cursorPlans.description: Browse, preview and manage your Cursor `*.plan.md` history from the side bar.
cursorPlans.viewContainer.title: Cursor Plans
cursorPlans.view.title: History
cursorPlans.welcome.empty:
No plans found yet.

Cursor saves plans to `~/.cursor/plans/` as `*.plan.md`. They will show up here automatically.

[Open settings](command:cursorPlans.configure)
[Refresh](command:cursorPlans.refresh)
cursorPlans.config.title: Cursor Plans
cursorPlans.config.globalPlansDir: Path to the global Cursor plans directory. Defaults to `~/.cursor/plans`.
cursorPlans.config.includeWorkspace: Include plans found inside the current workspace (matched by `workspaceGlobs`).
cursorPlans.config.workspaceGlobs: Glob patterns (relative to each workspace folder) used to discover plans inside the workspace.
cursorPlans.config.extraGlobs: Additional absolute or workspace-relative globs to include (e.g. `**/*.md` to list any markdown).
cursorPlans.config.sortBy: Sort order for plans inside each group.
cursorPlans.config.sortBy.name: Alphabetical by name.
cursorPlans.config.useCustomEditor: Register a custom editor for `*.plan.md` so opening one from the Explorer renders the plan view by default.
cursorPlans.config.confirmDelete: Ask for confirmation before deleting a plan from the side bar.
